title: Trace of the clearing machine
statement: Let $i$ be a work-tape index, $w$ a finite word, and $d$ a configuration whose state is the forward-sweep phase. Suppose that, at every offset $p$ from $-1$ through the length of $w$, tape $i$ at position equal to its head position plus $p$ contains the symbol of $w$ at offset $p$ when that offset is a word position, and is blank otherwise. Then, for every time $t$, the clearing machine started from $d$ has configuration given by the following trace: its forward-sweep configuration at time $t$ when $t\le |w|$, its rewind configuration indexed by $2|w|+1-t$ when $|w|<t\le 2|w|+1$, and its specified completed configuration thereafter. The completed configuration has the same data as $d$ except that the state is the done phase and tape $i$ is blank on the interval from its initial head position inclusive to that position plus $|w|$ exclusive.
hypotheses_covered: Initial configuration $d$ is in the sweep phase
Tape $i$ agrees with the buffer word at all offsets $-1\le p\le |w|$
